title: Chapter 102: The People'S Will
content:
Chapter 102: The People'S Will

"Duan Wenxi, hand over all the remaining strategic materials to me and return to the inner wall."

Duan Wenxi immediately ran over, handed over the materials, and said with red eyes and sobs: "Boss, you... have to... take care!"

"Why are you crying? I'm not dead yet. If I die, I will die before you. Go back quickly."

Wang Shuo took the backpack from Duan Wenxi.

Looking at Duan Wenxi crying, Wang Shuo was already in a state of confusion, and now he was even more anxious.

Wang Shuo was completely dissatisfied with these logistics personnel, and drove them all to the inner wall.

But what they saw was that Wang Shuo took the lead and stood in front of them.

Although they all came from Blue Star, they definitely didn't want to depend on anyone in their bones.

Basically, they looked at Wang Shuo with the mentality of boss and employee.

But at this moment.

Their mentality changed.

Since they have to adapt to this game, they must accept the change of identity and role.

And following such a lord seems...

It's also good.

Although at this time, most of the people in the territory have already felt that this battle is bound to be lost.

But they all hope that their lord can create a miracle!

Even Dongfang Ling, who has always been unconvinced, has crystal eyes and a turbulent heart.

The eyes looking at Wang Shuo are gradually blurred and full of admiration.

"Lord, I am willing to fight side by side with you."

Someone shouted.

This completely ignited the depressed mood of the crowd.

"I am also willing to live and die with the lord."

"Wang Shuo, I, Yan Fujie, obey you today. I have always been a little unconvinced before. From now on, you are my lord."

"Count me in as Radul. As long as you can lead me to live today, I will give you my life."

"Count me in, I..."

...

The surrounding militias were also infected by the emotions, and they competed to show their loyalty one by one.

"Count me in, I..."

...

Wang Shuo was stunned for a while, and his heart could not calm down for a long time.

Could it be... Is this the will of the people?

Wang Shuo immediately checked the will of the people in the territory.

Wow, the average value reached 97 points.

He remembered that at the beginning, it was only 78 points.

What shocked Wang Shuo even more was that the loyalty of 5 people in the territory reached 100/100.

At this moment, Wang Shuo was a little uneasy.

He had always been very wary of these people in the territory.

He did not trust them at all.

But at this moment, his heart was shaken.

[The average loyalty of the people in Wana Village reached 97 points, activating the territory attribute "People's Will" (activatable when loyalty is above 90)]

[People's Will: The territory is stable and united, the efficiency of implementing government orders is increased by 20%, the willingness of people in the territory to join the army is increased by 20%, and they are more willing to follow the lord to fight the enemy. ]

Wang Shuo felt much better when he saw this territory attribute.

Before he could experience it well, his expression suddenly changed.

Because, on the one hand, some logistics team members ran out.

These are the foundations of the territory's development, and they cannot be easily destroyed!

On the other hand, the bosses' attacks have already landed on the light wall.

"Go back quickly. The boss's attack is too high. You have no defensive equipment and your health is too low, so you will be killed instantly."

"Swear to live and die with the lord!"

Someone else shouted.

Although Wang Shuo was very moved, he wanted to curse even more.

Damn it, we can still barely hold on, you are completely cannon fodder, and your death is worthless. Isn't it good to keep your life to build the territory?

"Yan Fujie, Ladul, I order you two to go back and preside over the arrow tower and energy tower on the inner wall." Wang Shuo had to find a job for them.

While eating, Wang Shuo had already ordered Matar to continue making arrows.

"Yes, lord."

The two ran back happily.

"Boom."

With a loud bang, the city wall collapsed.

Wang Shuo saw the boss's true appearance: White Wolf King, Tiger, Spider, Bull, Beetle...

Each one was huge, with fangs on its face, and a fierce look.

It was hard to mess with at first glance.

And there were a few ordinary beasts that rushed in.

"Li Jianguo, quickly push the bronze crossbow cart to the inner wall, and then give priority to killing the wild antelope boss."

"Militia squad, quickly move closer, in groups of ten, cross-cover. Just hold the boss back."

"Cavalry squad, in groups of two, fight together."

"Fight close to the inner wall, if you can't win, retreat immediately."

A series of orders came out of Wang Shuo's mouth.

Wang Shuo was not sure if his subordinates could delay long enough to create more attack opportunities for the bronze crossbow cart.
